column1: # Input repair (spec/input-repair.md, REP-1 … REP-9). Two kinds of rows.
# Operation rows (kind = the operation): a candidate reading of noisy input and its fixed cost. The
# analyzer tries them only inside a span whose own reading fires a check row below. A repaired reading
# must be a dictionary reading that fires no check row; among those, the lowest total cost wins, and
# then the analyzer's own order. cond: conditions of the operation (key=value, joined by &).
#   kata-fold  katakana read as hiragana; only in a particle, auxiliary, suffix or dependent verb, in the
#              inflection of a word, or in a word whose spelling mixes hiragana and katakana (once per word)
#   small-big  a small kana read as its big kana or the reverse (ゃ/や, っ/つ, ぁ/あ …), each letter
#   elong      a ー, 〜 or ～ run, a vowel letter that repeats the vowel before it, or an inserted っ dropped
#   stutter    a letter that repeats the letter before it dropped (屋屋, ささ), each run
#   space      a space or line break inside a word dropped
#   dakuten    a missing dakuten or handakuten restored (か→が, は→ぱ), each letter
#   swap       two adjacent kana transposed (once per span); minlen: the word holding them has at least
#              that many letters, unless each is part of a function word or of an inflection
#   edit1      one kana substituted, inserted or dropped (once per word); kana words only, minlen letters
#              or more, never a proper noun or a word read as a name
# Check rows (kind bad.tok on one token t, bad.pair on adjacent tokens l r, bad.space on a space between
# Japanese letters that the analyzer reads inside one word once the space is dropped): a reading is invalid where
# `when` holds and `require` does not (require - : invalid whenever `when` holds). Atoms are joined by &,
# alternatives of require by ||: [!]side.field=v1|v2 (exact), side.field^=v1|v2 (prefix) or side.field$=v1|v2 (suffix).
# Fields: ud ctype cform lemma surf pos (UniDic and IR names), arc (lex unk long stutter repair edge),
# derive (ja/derive.tsv row), script (hira kata kanji mixed sym other), lemmascript (kata other),
# space is 1 only for a single space in a line not laid out with spaces (two or more between Japanese
# letters); the space operation joins only those.
# triple (1: the token keeps the third letter of a run of one kanji or hiragana letter in running text),
# sokuon (1: keeps a っ before a letter that never follows it), fold (none part all: katakana letters read as hiragana), firstkata lastkata (1: the first or last letter is
# katakana as written), len (letters), elong (end infl mid: where a spoken lengthening sits, ー or 〜 after hiragana or a run of one vowel), prevcc nextcc (class of the
# letter before and after: hira kata kanji mark (ー 〜) sym edge), space (1 when a space comes before the token).
# same=surf: l and r have the same text. Until ja/conn.tsv lands, the bad.pair rows stand in for its
# hard adjacency of POS and cForm.
# Parameter rows (kind param): lists the operations and checks read; the list is in `when`
# (POS prefixes joined by |, or a string of letters).
